HIS ANSWER TOOK NEITHER OPTION WE OFFERED and specified the map instead: procedural generation with guard rails on rest placement; a toggle for multi-use rest stops; REST SITES BECOME WHERE YOU LEVEL, cinders spent past a threshold; 1 stat point per level; 10-20 level-ups a run, scalable — a range with a unit, i.e. an acceptance test of his, not ours. THE ONE UNREAD WORD WAS ANSWERED WHILE THIS ROW WAS BEING WRITTEN AND IS NOT LEFT OPEN HERE: 'restaurants' was dictation for REST (GRACE) SITES — 'so eletes, maybe shop, and definitely before a boss' — recorded verbatim by Marina in directions.md ('THREE ANSWERS IN ONE HOUR', c72f128, 2026-08-15).
